text: Did the young man speak English?
I had an amusing experience last year.
zh: 去年我经历了一件有趣的事。
zh_hant: 去年我經歷了一件有趣的事。

text: After I had left a small village in the south of France,
zh: 在我离开法国南部的一个小村庄之后，
zh_hant: 在我離開法國南部的一個小村莊之後，

text: I drove on to the next town.
zh: 我继续开车前往下一个城镇。
zh_hant: 我繼續開車前往下一個城鎮。

text: On the way, a young man waved to me.
zh: 在路上，一个年轻人向我挥手。
zh_hant: 在路上，一個年輕人向我揮手。

text: I stopped and he asked me for a lift.
As soon as he had got into the car,
I said good morning to him in French and he replied in the same language.
zh: 我就用法语向他问好，他也用法语回答。
zh_hant: 我就用法語向他問好，他也用法語回答。

text: Apart from a few words, I do not know any French at all.
zh: 除了一些单词，我完全不懂法语。
zh_hant: 除了一些單詞，我完全不懂法語。

text: Neither of us spoke during the journey.
zh: 旅途中我们谁都没有说话。
zh_hant: 旅途中我們誰都沒有說話。

text: I had nearly reached the town,
when the young man suddenly said,
As I soon learnt, he was English himself!
zh: 我很快就明白了，他自己就是英国人！
zh_hant: 我很快就明白了，他自己就是英國人！
